header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH BENCH AT SUKKUR
[Muhammad Ramzan v. P.O Sindh and others]
For Petitioner : Mr. Achar Khan Gabol, Advocate
For Respondents : M/s Ali Raza Balouch & Israr Ahmed
body: Andan Iqbal Chaudhry J.- In the recruitment process held in the year 2024, the petitioner was selected for the post of Police Constable in the Sindh Police, District Ghotki on the deceased quota. However, upon the requisite medical screening test, he was found to be infected with Hepatitis “C” virus and, therefore, his selection was withdrawn. Pursuant to order dated 28.08.2024, the petitioner was re-screened for the virus. Again, he tested „reactive‟. This fact is noted in the order dated 10.10.2024.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that even the second screening process was defective yet again prays for a third screening test.

The recruitment process, during which the petitioner was found infected with Hepatitis “C”, has since concluded. We are not inclined to re-open same by way repeated re-screening exercises for that would be a discrimination with other candidates similarly placed who were declined for the same reason. However, we agree with learned counsel that petitioner having been recommended for appointment on the deceased quota he will be at liberty to apply afresh as and when he is cured from the virus provided fresh vacancies are advertised. With that observation, the petition is dismissed.
J U D G E J U D G E M.Ali*
